## Wave 2 Summary

This wave attacks the framework's load-bearing causal-structure gaps from the substrate side, using exact-GR machinery the framework has my-namesake's-mandate to use but has not executed in the dynamical-cosmological context. It translates four seed findings into four COMPUTE gates: (1) the SHARPEST internal contradiction C-1 — the S85 PROVEN bracketed-pair white hole vs the S95 FAIL single-asymmetric-open white hole — re-attacked from the substrate by re-deriving `c_s(τ)` from the *actual* `a₂(τ)` spectral stiffness (which S95 held constant) and recounting zeros of `(v−c_s)`, with BOTH outcomes `N_zeros∈{1,2}` pre-registered as structural resolutions (a two-branch verdict, NOT a PASS/FAIL threshold); (2) the τ↔t map gap G1 via Raychaudhuri focusing for the reduced `(a(t),τ(t))` congruence, localizing the un-fixed scale `w=M_KK` to a single term and cross-checking `q∝H` against `S101-W1-QEQ-SELFCONS` PASS; (3) the off-trajectory censorship-robustness gap G3 via Christodoulou's bounded-variation strong-cosmic-censorship criterion on the exactly-solvable extremal `(κ=0)` modulus horizon `Σ_dump` (sealed vs dynamically-avoided); (4) the no-compact-object gap G2 + the incomplete-12D-acoustic-metric gap G4 via Gregory-Laflamme stability of the **dynamical** product M⁴×SU(3) — a long-wavelength mode along the SU(3) directions as τ evolves (the KK-bubble channel), which is a strictly LARGER question than the static-fiber `GL-STABILITY-63` PASS this gate builds on. Gate-type mix: compute×4. Three of four carry a `[SIGN]` trigger (the zero-count sign, the Raychaudhuri focusing-term sign, the GL growth-rate sign).

## Wave 2 Decision Point Prerequisites

This wave has **no intra-investigation upstream-verdict prerequisites** — all four gates consume only EXISTING, on-disk session-track data anchors (verified at plan-freeze; see the Input-SHA Ledger) plus `canonical_constants.py`. None of the four gates consumes another inv-4 gate's output, so there is no intra-wave forward-pin and no mechanical-closure exposure within this wave (`mechanical-closure-discipline.md` does not fire — every gate is independently dispatchable). The cross-wave relationship to Wave 1 / Wave 3 is informational only:

- INV4-W2-1's zero-count verdict is the substrate-side input the routed-out hygiene items HY1 (redraw Diagram J) and HY2 (capstone causal-disconnection down-tag) consume at `/rclab-investigate --investigation 4` close — but those are session-track curated-register edits OUTSIDE this investigation (track-local boundary, `gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"`), not gates here.
- INV4-W2-2 (Raychaudhuri, a₂/invariant-focusing reading of the clock) is the complementary partner of INV4-W3-1 (de Sitter a₀-horizon reading of the clock); the seed flags that if both land on the same moment the C2 tension resolves and a divergence seeds a FUTURE workshop (NOT planned this round). W2-2 does not depend on W3-1 — they are independent computes that the consolidator compares post-hoc.

W2-3's Christodoulou question becomes a property of the modulus-space extremal horizon alone (no acoustic sealed interior to seal).

SAME moment → the C2 a₀-vs-a₂ tension resolves (both clocks in one moment). - **INV4-W2-3** (Christodoulou SCC): INEXTENDIBLE → the triple-censorship claim is robust at the extremal horizon (G3 robustness confirmed). EXTENDIBLE → censorship is dynamical-avoidance-only (a capstone-hygiene down-tag candidate routed out at close). MARGINAL (INFO) → extremal horizon at the censorship boundary.
- **INV4-W2-4** (dynamical GL): Track B (bubble) → the framework's first compact-object-like channel; carry-forward the 12D acoustic-metric perturbation lift (G4) and the λ_GL compactness scale into a session-mode plan (an investigation result becomes permanent only when promoted into a session, `gate-verdicts.md §"Track-local boundary"`). Track A (GL-stable) → a dynamical-stability layer added to the censorship structure; G2 remains an open gap.

All four verdicts are exploratory-track results under `computations/investigation-4/inv4_gate_verdicts.txt`; none mutates a session-track curated register. ## Wave 2 Input-SHA Ledger

Every input file the four COMPUTE gates consume. Static files carry a precomputed SHA-256 head (verified on disk at plan-freeze, 2026-06-14); the producing scripts recompute and verify the full 64-char hash at execution (`<computed-at-runtime>` in the gate blocks).

| `computations/session-84/s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz` | W2-1, W2-2, W2-4 | `9e6d9cf7fd6a6949` | L12 Peter-Weyl D_K spectrum, `sector_evals` dict {(p,q): evals}, 90 sectors — a₂(τ) stiffness (W2-1), a₀/a₂ moment decomposition (W2-2), Peter-Weyl harmonic block structure (W2-4) |

All four inputs are EXISTING session-track artifacts (verified present on disk at plan-freeze). No input is itself an inv-4 gate output, so the Input-SHA ledger is complete and acyclic — every gate is independently dispatchable. Per the track-local boundary (`gate-verdicts.md`), consuming session-track data files as READ-ONLY inputs is permitted; what an investigation must NOT do is WRITE to session-track curated registers (the routed-out HY1–HY6 hygiene edits).
